payload.description_html: Dasosaurus is a macronarian sauropod dinosaur whose discovery has helped clarify sauropod dispersal in the Cretaceous. Not a true titanosaur, its discovery in what is now Brazil places it in a pivotal evolutionary and geographic position, bridging earlier sauropods of the northern continents with the true giants known from South America.
